items.desc: The two leaders inaugurate a motorable bridge linking Darchula with India and the second phase of a petroleum pipeline, and lay foundation stones for an integrated check post, oil terminal and hydropower project.

items.title: Shah-Modi bilateral talks conclude in New Delhi
items.desc: Senior ministers, security officials and top diplomats from both countries take part in the high-level discussions during the Nepali prime minister’s state visit to India.

items.title: Parsa National Park to build two more waterholes for wildlife
items.desc: The park has 40 reinforced-concrete waterholes, but limited natural water sources leave wildlife struggling for water during the dry season.

items.title: Shah, Modi hold one-on-one talks in New Delhi
items.desc: The meeting at Hyderabad House is expected to last more than half an hour, with the two sides set to hold delegation-level talks afterwards.

items.title: Shah says compassion is ultimate strength in tribute to Gandhi
items.desc: In a message at Raj Ghat, Nepal’s prime minister draws a parallel between Gandhi’s legacy and the values of Buddha, while reaffirming Nepal’s commitment to its enduring ties with India.

items.title: PM Shah receives guard of honour in New Delhi
items.desc: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomes Shah at Rashtrapati Bhavan as the two sides prepare for talks on bilateral cooperation and key pending issues

items.title: Alice Huang in touch with Chinese spy agency during affair with Nvidia CEO, NYT says
items.desc: US officials say they have yet to determine whether Huang spied for China, as the case intensifies scrutiny of Washington’s semiconductor export controls.

items.title: Karnali steps up preparations for 10th National Games
items.desc: Around 6,500 athletes from 11 teams will compete in 32 sports, with most events scheduled in Surkhet as the province prepares venues, accommodation and security.

items.title: Five parties plan to contest local, provincial elections under common symbol
items.desc: The parties have consulted the Election Commission on using a single symbol, saying they share an agenda of securing proportional representation for marginalised communities.

items.title: Indian investors eye expansion in Nepal as Kathmandu courts fresh capital
items.desc: Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle urges Indian businesses to invest in technology, hydropower and connectivity, while the two countries’ private sectors agree to cooperate on flood recovery.

items.title: Can climate diplomacy build on the collapse of COP31?
items.desc: The failure to reach a deal in Antalya has renewed calls to reform UN climate talks, even as smaller alliances and market forces increasingly drive climate action.

items.title: How ‘Elephants in the Fog’ reimagines motherhood and the power of chosen family
items.desc: Abinash Bikram Shah’s acclaimed film offers a moving portrait of chosen family, unconditional love and the cruelty of social conformity through the story of a Kinnar matriarch and her adopted daughters.

items.title: Q&A: MCC officials on opening the gates of Lord’s and beyond for Nepal
items.desc: In an exclusive interview, MCC administrators, Robert Lawson and Rob Lynch, reflect on the magic of the Home of Cricket, the rise of Associate nations, and why June’s tour is just the beginning for Nepal.

items.title: Months after flood devastated families, survivors live in trauma
items.desc: Loss of loved ones, homes and livelihoods, coupled with uncertainty over the future, is taking a heavy toll on the people displaced by the Bhotekoshi disaster.

items.title: India likely to announce $1.5 billion package for Nepal, air-route deal under discussion
items.desc: New Delhi hints at a ‘surprise’ announcement by Modi as PM Shah begins his first state visit; Nepal has sought $2 billion in grants and lines of credit.

items.title: Biratnagar’s three-year-old rail cargo infrastructure is crumbling
items.desc: Despite the commissioning of the Bathnaha-Biratnagar railway line, cargo trains have failed to operate regularly as the yard, platforms, storage areas and internal roads have already suffered damage due to poor maintenance.

items.title: Government must deliver justice to conflict victims to complete the peace process
items.desc: Twenty years after the Comprehensive Peace Accord, thousands of conflict victims are still waiting for justice.

items.title: Ben-gate: Heights of advisory overreach
items.desc: PM Shah must start investigations against his adviser, beginning with graciously sacking him for the time being.

items.title: Can COP31 restore confidence in global climate cooperation?
items.desc: For climate-vulnerable countries, the negotiations at COP31 cover economic growth, fiscal stability, food security, infrastructure, employment and livelihoods.

items.title: Nepal register their 50th win in their 100th ODI
items.desc: The Rhinos were playing their 100th ODI when they faced the UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars on Sunday. Nepal won it by six wickets.
